newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Telstra/Optus cable sharing approval possible-ACCC.
newsitem.headline: Telstra/Optus cable sharing approval possible-ACCC.

text.p: Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) said on Tuesday it may possibly give approval to any proposed bid between Telstra Corp and Optus Communications to share their communications infrastructure.
"It is possible to be acceptable under the act," ACCC chairman Allan Fels told reporters after giving a speech to the Committee for Economic Development of Australia (CEDA).

Optus said on Monday that it was still in talks with fellow telecoms group Telstra about sharing their respective infrastructure to deliver separate pay television services for both groups. Such a proposal would depend on ACCC approval.
